about_the_game:
RHM: The Foundation is a traversal-based music platformer where rhythm isn’t just heard—it’s played. You are Eli, a lone infiltrator in a fractured sonic dimension, racing across glowing landscapes to reclaim the five lost music stems that once held harmony together.

This is a moment-to-moment traversal challenge where movement is music, and music shapes the world.

🕶️ What to Expect

Traversal As Rhythm
Wall-jump, vault, and precision-dash your way through a reactive world. Every action feeds the soundtrack and fuels momentum.

Music-Driven Progression
Each collected stem dynamically layers into the soundtrack, evolving the world's vibe and intensity in real time.

Fast-Paced Challenge Loops
Every level is a timed obstacle course with its own musical identity and traversal rhythm. Collect all five stems and reach the extraction point—clean.

Stylized Audio Worlds
Explore surreal sonic structures where timing is everything and failure rewinds the beat. Replay to perfect your flow.

Narrative Through Vibes
OR’s voice guides you. The music speaks for the world. No cutscenes—just poetic dispatches from a lost legacy and the beat of your ascent.

🎮 Modes at Launch

  • Core Loop: Traverse → Collect 5 Stems → Extract

  • Time Challenge: Beat the clock

  • Perfect Run (Optional): No deaths, all stems, full track remix

🎧 Key Features

  • Five music stems per level that build into full reactive tracks

  • Ten hand-crafted traversal levels with evolving hazards

  • Real-time music remixing based on player performance

  • Minimalist UI, audio-based feedback system

  • OR’s cryptic voice lines set the tone before each mission

  • Instant restart loop (Celeste-style) to encourage mastery

  • No stealth, no combat—just rhythm, speed, and precision

The beat is waiting. The path is yours to perfect.
More features, game modes, and surprises are coming post-launch.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p @ 60fps on low/medium settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth gameplay with audio-reactive features at 1080p high settings
